sloka: नानाविधान् गृहच्छन्दान् ददाह हुतभूक् तदा।आवासान् राक्षसानां च सर्वेषां गृहगर्धिनाम् ।। ६.७५.१३ ।।
transliteration: nānāvidhān gṛhacchandān dadāha hutabhūk tadā।āvāsān rākṣasānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ gṛhagardhinām ।। 6.75.13 ।।

translations.english: With fire all over, rugs made of hair of animals, whisks made of fur of animals, tiger skins, musk, wonderful pearls, and gems in laid dwellings of many kinds, and clusters of war weapons were burnt.
